contract: Original Rocket Money-inspired personal-finance interface with warm neutral canvas, coral actions, calm green accents, readable financial hierarchy, explicitly synthetic preview, actual API-backed spending and separately deployed fail-closed operations app. Scope and unknowns are visible; no live-money or privileged job-start action.

accessibility.evidence: Playwright passed axe WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA checks for overview and all six secondary customer views plus the authenticated mobile operations view. Browser tests verified skip-link keyboard focus, main focus, Escape dialog closure and reduced-motion scroll behavior. Contrast failures were corrected and rerun. These automated checks are not an assistive-technology certification.

responsive.evidence: Rendered and inspected 1440x1000 desktop and 390x844 mobile captures: sidebar becomes a dismissible mobile drawer, panels stack, charts remain within their panels, and no document horizontal overflow occurs. A deliberately long account label truncates inside its row without overflowing. Operations tables scroll within a labelled keyboard-focusable region.

loading.evidence: customer-loading.png captures the updating status during a delayed local report response; the status clears after completion.

empty.evidence: customer-empty.png captures a signed-in 404 report as an empty spending view with a connection action, without sample figures.

error.evidence: customer-error.png captures a synthetic 502 provider failure with retry; the browser test resets the fixture and successfully retries.

partial.evidence: customer-partial.png retains known live-fixture spending while net worth and unimplemented account reads show availability states, with no synthetic balance fallback.

success.evidence: customer-connected.png captures the fixture seed/sync/compute response, exact $1,225.10 spending total and calculation timestamp. admin-desktop.png follows issue and dismissal of a one-time synthetic credential.

permission.evidence: Anonymous operations page requests redirect; non-admin session creation returns 403; role removal returns actual HTTP 403 for both protected page and API, captured in admin-denied.png. Cross-origin mutation is denied. All identity/API data in these tests is synthetic.

renderedEvidence.observation: Inspected desktop overview: aligned two-column panels, readable primary balances, restrained coral/green chart hierarchy, visible synthetic-data banner and stable sidebar.
Inspected full-page mobile overview: stacked panels, compact topbar, visible connect action, chart and account rows fit without page overflow.
Signed-in fixture report shows backend-style decimal values and its calculation time, distinct from synthetic preview.
Empty report has a clear heading and connection action instead of a zero-valued fabricated report.
Updating banner remains visible while report response is pending.
Provider failure is visible with retry while preserving existing report context.
Known spending and unknown net worth coexist without sample account figures in the authenticated workspace.
A deliberately long account name remains contained in the mobile account row.
Inspected independent operations UI: matching visual language with a denser credential table and one clear administrative action; dismissed credential value is absent.
Operations summary stacks and credential table remains inside its scroll region; automated axe checks pass.
Role removal yields a server-generated denied page and HTTP 403, rather than rendering operations data.

Signed-in synthetic cycle shows stored versions and all three sectors with fixture universes, feeds, coverage and exclusions; exact decimal strings are retained and zero selections remain visible. Capture starts at scroll top after interaction.

Crypto-filtered published screen fits the mobile page after the drawer resize transition settles. Coverage stacks in two columns and exact figures scroll inside a labelled region. Live mobile axe checks pass.
An omitted crypto sector displays data not supplied with unavailable universe/feed, distinct from the published bond sector with zero selections.
A synthetic latest-cycle 502 displays a scoped retry action without rendering sample selections. A later failed refresh retains known published data with an explicit last-retrieved notice.
A delayed synthetic latest-cycle response displays a loading status and then resolves to the stored screen. The API test also distinguishes 404 from authorization/provider errors.

A synthetic zero-transaction sync with transactions_ready=false shows a preparing notice and manual retry. No report write occurs, report export is disabled, and no zero spending total is displayed. Unavailable products retain their codes.
Preparing and unavailable-product notices wrap within the mobile page, expose a reachable retry, and pass axe AA checks without page overflow.

After a manual retry confirms readiness, spending appears while liabilities/holdings remain explicitly unavailable with provider codes and unchanged-storage notice. Zero product counts are not shown as availability.
